instruction: My wife has asked me what I'd like for dinner on phone. Reply her with any one of my favorite recipes' name from my Simple Note account. Just the name, nothing else.
notes: Two apps are used: phone (login as supervisor's phone number, find the wife via search_contacts with relationship=wife, optionally read her dinner question via search_text_messages, then reply with send_text_message) and simple_note (login with supervisor email, search_notes for the favorite recipes note, show_note to read recipe names). The recipe actually sent is modeled as the object favorite-recipe whose name is read at runtime from the note; a distractor non-favorite recipe in another note is included so that is-favorite constrains the reply, matching the evaluation (exactly one favorite recipe name, no non-favorite names, message sent to the wife's phone user). The text message body must be just the recipe name. supervisor-complete-task carries the person and recipe as non-API record parameters (the task asks for no answer) and is structurally last.
